{{Quote|A man with his skill and bearing doesn't end up on a dirtball like Phaeda without a reason.|[[Mirith Sinn]] remarks on [[Kir Kanos]]'s presence on Phaeda|<ref name="CE" />}}
'''Phaeda''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], with two rocky [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. Of little strategic or commercial importance, its [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] garrison was corrupt, and so the planet provided haven for many [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] and other [[Fringer/Legends|fringers]]. This led to diverse species finding a home on the planet, in addition to the many Human inhabitants.

==History==
{{Quote|This was Phaeda, after all. On a bad day it made Nar Shaddaa look classy.|Boba Fett's thought's of Phaeda|<ref name="Rev" />}}
During the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] era, Phaeda had its own [[Phaeda Planetary Defense Force|defense fleet]] that patrolled the system.<ref name="kotOR:W3">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 3|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 3]]</ref> During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the Republic recruited [[Phaeda Militia|militias]] on the planet to fight the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]].<ref name="kotOR:W1" /> The [[Carrick family]] lived on the planet by that time and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Zayne Carrick]] was from the world.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Handbook]]''</ref> In [[3962 BBY]], [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] [[Skirmish on Phaedacomm|attacked]] the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Phaedacomm]] at the edge of the Phaeda system. Although former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dorjander Kace]] tried to capture it without unnecessary bloodshed, the Mandalorians killed the entire station staff. The seizure of Phaedacomm cut off all communications of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="kotOR:W3" /> The [[Jedi Enclave]] on Dantooine was later [[Raid on Dantooine|targeted]] by the Mandalorians.<ref name="kotOR:W5">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 5|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 5]]</ref>

[[File:Phaeda_cityscape.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A city on Phaeda]]

[[Kir Kanos]] passed through this planet in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], killing a number of Imperial officers and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in a [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] there. He connected up with [[Tem Merkon]] and the local [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces. His presence attracted the attention of [[Carnor Jax]], who brought his personal troops to the planet to capture him. In an effort to avoid scrutiny of his corrupt activities, the local commander, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Xexus Shev]], endeavored to capture Kanos and destroy the rebel base. In a [[Battle of Phaeda|fierce battle]] his troops were destroyed, but the rebels were forced to retreat to their mountain base in the [[Collo Fauale Pass]].<ref name="CE" />

When Carnor Jax arrived, he executed Shev for his failure and took personal command. Capturing the rebel leader, he discovered that Kanos had left for [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]]. Departing to catch him, the Imperial troops attacked the rebels a second time. Their base was heavily damaged before the arrival of invading [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]. His forces included the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' and the elite [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].<ref name="CE" />

The world was [[Battle of the Phaeda system|conquered]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] by the invading [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. Toward the end of the Yuuzhan Vong invasion the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] liberated Phaeda and assumed control of the world.<ref name="TEA" />

Phaeda had a law that when a resident died without a will, all their property of value was held in storage by the [[Registry of Testaments and Legacies]] until someone with a claim could pay to have it released. In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Mirta Gev]] discovered that a [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] slab containing [[Sintas Vel]] was part of the estate of a gangster named [[Hidu Rezodar]]. The pair arranged to have the slab released into their custody. By that time, Phaeda had gained a habit of making [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] look classy.<ref name="Rev" />
